identity: Mono-black artifact aristocrats. Susurian Voidborn drains 1 life every time a creature or artifact you control DIES, and Lightless Evangel puts a +1/+1 counter on itself every time you SACRIFICE one — note the wording differs, and Voidborn is the broader trigger. Because every sacrifice is also a death, a single free outlet advances the drain and the clock at once, which means the opponent cannot interact with one without feeding the other. Umbral Collar Zealot and Swarm Culler are those outlets, and Beamsaw Prospector, Gravpack Monoist and Virus Beetle are expendable fodder that replace themselves on death. Sothera, the Supervoid turns the same death trigger into a repeatable one-sided edict, which is how a clock with no evasion gets through. Entropic Battlecruiser is demoted here to a conditional finisher: below 8 charge counters it is a noncreature artifact that neither attacks nor blocks and only converts this list's 2 discard sources into 3 life each, but 8 counters are more reachable in THIS build than in either other because the deck runs 16 creature cards and Station has no once-per-turn limit.

restrictions.extra_constraint: max 6 rares+mythics total across mainboard and sideboard

mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever you sacrifice another creature or artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

mainboard.name: Susurian Voidborn
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever this creature or another creature or artifact you control dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Warp {B} (You may cast this card from your hand for its warp cost. Exile this creature at the beginning of the next end step, then you may cast it from exile on a later turn.)

mainboard.name: Sothera, the Supervoid
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever a creature you control dies, each opponent chooses a creature they control and exiles it.
At the beginning of your end step, if a player controls no creatures, sacrifice Sothera, then put a creature card exiled with it onto the battlefield under your control with two additional +1/+1 counters on it.

mainboard.oracle_text:

mainboard.oracle_text:

mainboard.name: Entropic Battlecruiser
mainboard.oracle_text:

8+ | Flying, deathtouch
Whenever this Spacecraft attacks, each opponent discards a card. Each opponent who can't loses 3 life.

mainboard.oracle_text: As long as you control an artifact, this creature gets +1/+0 and has deathtouch.

mainboard.oracle_text: Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)

mainboard.name: Virus Beetle

mainboard.name: Decode Transmissions
mainboard.oracle_text:
You draw two cards and lose 2 life.
Void — If a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, instead you draw two cards and each opponent loses 2 life.

As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature.

mainboard.name: Tragic Trajectory
mainboard.oracle_text:
Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
Void — That creature gets -10/-10 until end of turn instead if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn.

sideboard.name: Dauntless Scrapbot
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, exile each opponent's graveyard. Create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
sideboard.when_to_board: vs graveyard decks (31 cube cards / 12.5% density). 'When this creature enters, exile each opponent's graveyard. Create a Lander token.' One-sided, and it arrives as two sacrificeable artifact permanents, so it is never a dead card.

sideboard.name: Thaumaton Torpedo
sideboard.oracle_text: {6}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy target nonland permanent. This ability costs {3} less to activate if you attacked with a Spacecraft this turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs enchantments (16 cube cards) and the 52 non-Spacecraft artifacts — together 36% of the cube's permanents, which the mainboard cannot touch at all. '{6}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy target nonland permanent.' Board it in knowing the real cost is {1} to cast plus {6} to activate: the {3} discount requires attacking with a Spacecraft, which this deck's Battlecruiser can only do at 8+ counters. It is a 1-mana artifact, so it deploys turn 1 and sits as free Zealot fodder until the game goes long enough to pay.

sideboard.name: Vote Out
sideboard.oracle_text:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
Destroy target creature.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs decks with one key creature or a flier the deck cannot block. 'Convoke ... Destroy target creature.' With 13 creature copies mainboard, Convoke makes this effectively {B} plus taps — unconditional removal at a real discount, unlike Gravkill's flat {3}{B}.

sideboard.name: Dubious Delicacy
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flash
When this artifact enters, up to one target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target opponent loses 3 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs decks with one key creature, and in any grind where the last points are hard to find. 'Flash / When this artifact enters, up to one target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn' plus '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target opponent loses 3 life' — removal, then fodder, then 3 points of reach.

sideboard.name: Depressurize
sideboard.oracle_text: Target creature gets -3/-0 until end of turn. Then if that creature's power is 0 or less, destroy it.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs go-wide and cheap aggressive starts. 'Target creature gets -3/-0 until end of turn. Then if that creature's power is 0 or less, destroy it.' — instant speed, which the mainboard removal (Tragic Trajectory, Embrace Oblivion) is not.

identity_es: Aristócratas de artefactos mono negro. Susurian Voidborn drena 1 vida cada vez que una criatura o artefacto que controlas MUERE, y Lightless Evangel se pone un contador +1/+1 cada vez que SACRIFICAS uno — ojo, la redacción difiere, y Voidborn es el disparo más amplio. Como cada sacrificio es también una muerte, un solo medio gratuito avanza el drenaje y el reloj a la vez, lo que significa que el rival no puede interactuar con uno sin alimentar el otro. Umbral Collar Zealot y Swarm Culler son esos medios, y Beamsaw Prospector, Gravpack Monoist y Virus Beetle son forraje prescindible que se reemplaza al morir. Sothera, the Supervoid convierte ese mismo disparo de muerte en un edicto unilateral repetible, que es como pasa un reloj sin evasión. Entropic Battlecruiser queda aquí degradada a finalizadora condicional: por debajo de 8 contadores de carga es un artefacto no-criatura que ni ataca ni bloquea y solo convierte las 2 fuentes de descarte de esta lista en 3 vidas cada una, pero 8 contadores son más alcanzables en ESTA construcción que en ninguna otra porque el mazo juega 16 cartas de criatura y Station no tiene límite por turno.
